name: Bina Agarwal
shortBio: Indian development economist and feminist political theorist whose empirical and conceptual work established the link between women’s independent land rights, intrahousehold bargaining power, and ecological stewardship.
centralQuestion: Why does transforming gender inequality require securing women’s independent property and commons governance rather than relying on unitary household models?

keyWorks.title: A Field of One's Own: Gender and Land Rights in South Asia
keyWorks.description: Pathbreaking comparative study proving that independent land titles reshape women’s bargaining power and social agency.

keyWorks.title: Gender and Green Governance
keyWorks.description: Advances feminist environmentalism via empirical analysis of women’s participation in community forest institutions.
